review_description: Sold me a 6kw , 21 panels solar system with a promise of zero billing with $300 - $400 rebate every quarter at 21c origin Energy. Single person living alone. Paid $5000 for this, installed in oct 2019, 1st bill $421.82? No feed in has been happening since installed. Contacted them, came to fix problem twice, blaming problem on Origin. Solar feed in now working. Received another bill of $268.86 in May. Out of pocket $1200 missing rebates & bills.
